# Rango Unchained (game)

The [libGDX](https://libgdx.com/) game *Rango Unchained*, a Bubble Trouble clone. Its game modes are
generated by the game mode DSL of this repository. See the [root README](../README.md) for the DSL,
the generator and the example editions.

## Layout

- `core/`: the game, shared by all platforms.
- `lwjgl3/`: the desktop launcher.
- `android/`: the Android launcher. It is only included in the build when an Android SDK is
  configured (`ANDROID_HOME`, `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT` or `local.properties`).

## Generated files

These files are written by the generator. Do not edit them by hand:

- `core/src/generated/java/io/github/RangoUnchained/Modes/Generated/`: one class per game mode, and
  `GeneratedEdition.java` with the edition's title, mode list and difficulties.
- `assets/modes/`: the arena of each level of each mode (`<Mode>-<n>.json`).
- `android/res/values/edition.xml`: the edition title for the Android launcher.

The checked-in files come from an earlier example (the Survival edition). To generate another
edition into this folder, run from the repository root:

```sh
./mvnw verify -Pgame -Dedition=arcade   # classic (the default), arcade or hardcore
```

The hand-written mode runtime that the generated classes build on is in
`core/src/main/java/io/github/RangoUnchained/Modes/`.

## Running

You need JDK 21. The Gradle wrapper downloads Gradle 9.8.2.

```sh
./gradlew lwjgl3:run    # start the desktop game, then pick a mode in the main menu
./gradlew lwjgl3:jar    # runnable jar in lwjgl3/build/libs/
```

## Controls

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `A` / `D` | Move left / right |
| `SPACE` | Shoot the tongue |
